tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings during a full-stack internship at Sunflower Trip.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Built a full-stack trading platform across three services (marketing site, trading dashboard, and Express API) with JWT-based authentication using httpOnly cookies and per-user data scoping.
Developed DriftGuard, a MERN-stack tool with a teammate to flag real-time configuration and security drift and mapped detected changes to NIST and GDPR compliance controls.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer Intern role at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies Private Limited in Bangalore. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my internship as a Full Stack Developer at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. I also implemented role-based access control and secure authentication to separate admin and user workflows. Furthermore, in my personal projects such as Zenvest, a stock trading platform clone, I built a full-stack application leveraging the MERN stack, Express APIs, and JWT-based authentication. I am comfortable working with the MERN stack and cloud deployments. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my backend and full-stack experience aligns with your team's needs.
